verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://www.canva.dev/llms.txt, which indexes Canva's developer documentation. Section-level llms.txt files exist for SCIM, Admin and audit logs, and doc pages are served as Markdown (mcp.md, connect.md, apps.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs, and the root docs Markdown path (/docs/.md) returned 404.
